g.text: System Context View: Agent Session Manager (ax)
System Context diagram for Agent Session Manager.
Browses, selects, confirms, launches, and attaches
Submits typed projected reads and guarded mutations
Reads allowlisted source-local metadata and exact heads
Owns task-board integration; backend has no task-board authority
Presents inside one host-local TerminalInstance without changing ownership
Owns replication and takeover; presentation transport carries no authority
